summary: Woman's lightweight folding kayak collapsed on a log in the Arkansas River about a mile below the Lake Pueblo dam near the Cottonwood Day Use area, trapping her foot; passing bicyclists called 911. CPW Ranger Daryl Seder donned a swiftwater rescue dry suit, attached a safety rope, swam to her and freed her foot; Pueblo West Fire Department pulled her to shore. A medical team checked her foot and ankle and she was able to leave on her own.
location: Arkansas River ~1 mile below Lake Pueblo dam, near Cottonwood Day Use area
responding_agency: Colorado Parks & Wildlife; Pueblo West Fire Department
